path_base: All asset and prompt paths are relative to akari-v3.2/.

existing_image_edit.note: The edit target owns composition, camera and pose. Supporting images supply only assigned details.

usage_rules: Open relevant native images with view_image before generation and explicitly assign each role.
Use B2 as the face and pop rendering authority. Never replace it with the small face from G1 or a scene.
Use G1 for body balance and the soda-blue gingham outfit; new expressions, poses and cameras may vary.
Generate new scenes independently from the same B2/G1. Scene selection does not promote a new face authority.
The user-approved v3.2 B face redesign supersedes the v3.1 exact eye-rendering lock for v3.2 work.
Historical P1/P2/U1/L1 document lineage, not an instruction to restore the older face or uniform.
F09 supplies only soft opaque cloth and shallow sparse wrinkles. White short socks and sneakers follow G1. Do not expose hidden toes or draw individual toe shapes through cloth.
The silver pin stays one plain thin straight bar at character-left temple, without beads.
